Fixture: the rule no-suite-source-clone-in-workflows in .github/invariants.txt
has to match nothing in this file.

Each line is what a workflow legitimately says near the thing the rule refuses.
Every one of them names the suite's repository, because naming it is not the
violation and a rule that reads the name as the violation refuses most of what
this project has to do.

    - run: gh api repos/FreeCAD/FreeCAD --jq '.license.spdx_id'
    - run: gh api repos/FreeCAD/FreeCAD/contents/src/Mod?ref=1.1.3
    - run: gh release download 1.1.3 --repo FreeCAD/FreeCAD --pattern '*.AppImage'
    - run: git clone https://github.com/iderex/reissbrett.wiki.git
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
          repository: iderex/reissbrett

The third line is the one the effort went into. #11 decided that the bundle is
the product and that it ships the suite's published artefact unchanged, so a
step that downloads a release is the delivery form working as decided. #4 says
the same thing from the other side: fetching a release artefact and shipping it
unchanged is not the act the rule refuses. A rule that reds that step reds #108.

The fourth line reaches for the git command against something that is not the
suite, and the sixth reaches for the checkout input against this project's own
tree. Both are one token away from a refused line above.
